Minimum hand → 1 Rev in 1 hour

Hour hand → 1 rev in 12 hours

⇒ Speeds of a> Minute hand → 360° per hour

Time between coincide = 360/330=12/11 hour

⇒ In 12 hours → 12/(12/11)=11

नया योग है,

questions.q_en: A, B and C donate 8%, 7% and 9%, of their salaries respectively to a charitable trust. The salaries of A and B are same and the difference between their donations is ₹259. The total donation of A and B is ₹1,185 more than that of C. The total donation of A and C is what percentage of the total salaries of A, B and C? [Correct to one decimal place]
questions.q_hi: A, B और C अपने वेतन का क्रमशः 8%, 7% और 9% एक धर्मार्थ ट्रस्ट को दान करते हैं। A और B का वेतन समान है और उनके दान के बीच का अंतर ₹259 है। A और B का कुल दान C के दान से ₹1,185 अधिक है। A और C का कुल दान A, B और C के कुल वेतन का कितना प्रतिशत है? [एक दशमलव स्थान तक सही]

questions.solution_en:
Let salary of A = salary of B = 100x
So, difference between their Donation = 8x - 7x
x→259

259×15=3885
Donation of C = 3885 – 1185 = 2700
C→9 unit→2700
1 unit→300
100 unit→30,000[salary of C]
Total donation of A & C = 2072 +2700 = 4772
Total salary of A, B & C together= 25900 + 25900 + 30000 = 81800
= ×100=5.8%

questions.q_en: The ratio of the incomes of A and B in 2020 was 5:4. The ratios of their individual incomes in 2020 and 2021 were 4:5 and 2: 3, respectively. If the total income of A and B in 2021 was 7,05,600, then what was the income [in ₹] of B in 2021?
questions.q_hi: 2020 में A और B की आय का अनुपात 5:4 था। 2020 और 2021 में उनकी व्यक्तिगत आय का अनुपात क्रमशः 4:5 और 2:3 था। यदि 2021 में A और B की कुल आय 7,05,600 थी, तो 2021 में B की आय [₹ में] क्या थी?
options_en: ₹3,45,600
₹2,79,700
₹3,60,000
₹4,25,900
options_hi: ₹3,45,600

questions.solution_en:
A : B
   5 : 4
×8 ×8
The ratio of the incomes of A and B in 2020 = 40 : 32
Ratio of A’s incomes in 2020 and 2021 = 4:5 → 40 : 50
Ratio of B’s incomes in 2020 and 2021=2: 3→ 32:48
Total income of A and B in 2021→ 98
98 → ₹7,05,600
The income of B in 2021=₹ ×48 = ₹3,45,600
